The '''Korriban Arrival Port''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of Korriban during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was near the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Academy]] and the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] and was mostly used for [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to drop potential [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] who were then taken to the Academy. There, their respective training [[Overseer (Sith)|overseers]] would meet and brief them on the basics of [[Sith training]]. Both the second [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] and [[Darth Nox]] were [[Imperial assault shuttle|dropped off]] here when they were still potential acolytes.
